title: This Animal's Eyes Are Bigger Than Its Brain: The Tarsier

scenes.text: This animal's eyes are bigger than its brain.
It's a tarsier, and it weighs only three to five ounces.
Each eye is larger than its brain, the biggest eyes for body size of any mammal.
It can turn its head a full 180 degrees in either direction to spot prey.
Then it leaps over six feet and snatches insects, even out of the air.
It's the only primate that eats nothing but meat, including birds and snakes. Eyes bigger than its brain, remember.

description:
This animal's eyes are bigger than its brain.
The tarsier weighs only 3 to 5 ounces, can turn its head 180 degrees each way, leaps over 6 feet, and is the only primate with a fully meat-based diet.
Would you want eyes that big? Comment below.
first_comment: Its head turns 180 degrees each way. Which tarsier superpower would you steal?
